title: understudy.benchmark_version.v1
description: One line of the versions.jsonl sidecar next to a benchmark.json manifest (append-only, newest last). Promotes the viewer convention (created_at / splits_sha256 / contamination / note lines) into the documented schema family, additively extended with a benchmark-level semantic version and per-task bump records that drive the rerun/regrade/reuse contract: a task's env change => major => rerun, verifier change => minor => regrade, meta change => patch => reuse. Producers may add extra fields; consumers must ignore fields they do not understand. References only — never inline gold, prompts, or secrets.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this version line was appended.

version.description: Benchmark-level semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) in force as of this line — the max bump across task_bumps since the previous line.

splits_sha256.description: sha256 of the frozen split contract at this version (matches manifest splits.splits_sha256).

contamination.description: Contamination verdict at this version, same enum as manifest splits.contamination.

note.description: Human-readable note for this version line.

from.description: Task semver before the change; null when the task is new.

to.description: Task semver after the change; null when the task was removed.

bump.description: major = env group changed (rerun), minor = verifier group changed (regrade), patch = meta only (reuse).

reason.description: Which field group(s) or lifecycle event (added/removed) caused the bump.

task_bumps.description: Per-task version changes recorded in this line. Absent/empty for legacy split-freeze-only lines.
